title: claim_ring
description: The target player claims a ring they have not claimed, e.g. to resolve an effect: unclaimed or contested (Display of Power), or taken from the claimed ring pool of another player (Roving Michibiku). It goes to their claimed ring pool, with the fate on it. The ring is claimed in `conflict_type`, by default the type of the conflict it was claimed in (a ring taken), else the type of the conflict being resolved; outside of a conflict, `conflict_type` is required for a ring nobody has claimed. A contested ring claimed this way is not claimed again by the winner of the conflict.

ring.description: Ring to claim: unclaimed, contested or claimed by another player.

conflict_type.description: Type of the conflict the ring is claimed in; by default, the type it was claimed in (taken from another player), else the type of the conflict being resolved.
